verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform. Serving as a cap-table system of record (share classes, certificates, SAFEs, option grants) that investors and auditors rely on is a different product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude ships such a ledger; generic file or Artifact creation would at most be a user-side workaround, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can maintain my full cap table — share classes, certificates, SAFEs, and option grants — as a live single source of truth that investors and auditors rely on
